verdict.rationale: A tax agency's online services could plausibly offer a programmatic or headless interface, so this axis applies. The evidence only documents interactive Online Services, Web File and Quick Pay web workflows. Probes found no OpenAPI or swagger spec, no llms.txt and no docs-md, and the /e-services/ transaction paths are robots-disallowed. Filing through 'approved software' is a third-party channel, not a headless or CI mode of the product itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
